verdict.rationale: Drata documents an OAuth-based API credential flow (drata-docs-6) and explicitly markets AI-agent integration via its API (drata-docs-2), implying token-based auth could be used to scope agent access, but there is no explicit documentation of granular least-privilege scopes, per-agent permission sets, or scoped API key issuance tailored to AI agents. Missing for 10: explicit scope/permission granularity docs, least-privilege configuration UI or API, and any hands-on/independent confirmation that OAuth tokens can be scoped down for agent use.
